name: Windfury Ridge
summary: Windfury Ridge rises above Mulgore’s pastures, where harpies nest among wolves and cougars. Its slopes endanger travelers, and tauren hunters seek the harpies’ feathers.

sections.title: A Perilous Perch
sections.body: Windfury Ridge rises above Mulgore’s plains, its crags home to Windfury harpies. They swoop at wanderers who stray too close. Prairie wolves and mountain cougars prowl the rocky slopes, making this edge of the tauren heartland dangerous. Tauren warriors hunt the harpies for their iridescent feathers, sought in Thunder Bluff for ceremonial garments worn at feasts and weddings.

faq.answer: Prairie wolves and mountain cougars prowl Windfury Ridge’s slopes. Harpies nest along the heights and dive at intruders who come too near.

faq.q: Why do the tauren hunt the harpies on Windfury Ridge?
faq.answer: Tauren hunt Windfury harpies to defend the borders and gather their brilliant feathers. The plumes are woven into ceremonial headdresses and decorations for feasts and weddings.
Windfury Ridge lies on elevated bluffs in northern Mulgore, beyond Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, you know Windfury Ridge as a recurring nuisance to young hunters and a source of ceremonial ornaments for marriages and seasonal gatherings.
As a hunter, you can use the steep slopes and cunning predators to practice tracking, beast taming and range management.
